text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is common in municipal government and, on its own, proves little — it's context, not evidence. Treated as your headline argument, it looks speculative and puts people on the defensive.

Your stronger facts are concrete: a master's plus professional licence against a bachelor's, twelve years of planning experience, and an unanswered written request after two weeks.

So pursue the process, not the panel. Re-send your request in writing, citing any municipal or records-access rules, and ask for the scoring criteria and weightings. If "public consultation" was weighted heavily and only surfaced after the fact, or if selection records are thin, you have something real. Note the panel composition in your own file; raise it later only if the documents support it.
